caption_L1: This is a bar diagram named Number of new coronavirus (COVID-19) cases confirmed in Czechia in 2020 , by region. The y-axis plots Number of people with linear scale of range 0 to 2,000 while the x-axis measures region of the Czech Republic on categorical scale starting at Hlavní město Praha and ending at Ústecký kraj.
caption_L2L3: The Bar Chart indicates that the Hlavni mesto Praha region had the highest number of cases of the Coronavirus in Czechia with over 2000 people infected, with the second highest region in the Moravskoslezsky kraj with just under 2000 people infected. This would indicate that the two regions may be a hotspot for Czech Republican Civilians to avoid.
